notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
[b]The game has just received a major update![/b]

[i]Here's what awaits you within:[/i]

[list]
[*] Two new localizations: Korean and Japanese languages
[*] A new system for tracking found items in the easy mode, making progression even easier
[*] Official game walkthrough added to the Steam guides section

[i]As well as...[/i]


[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[*] Reduced time to skip the snake puzzle (new values: 3 and 5 minutes for each difficulty level respectively. Previously: 5 and 10 minutes)
[*] Updated visual hints for solving the zoo puzzle (easy mode)
[*] The custom mosaic from the bonus section is now always accessible without playing the main storyline
[*] The game works with new Steam SDK now


[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[*] Fixed bugs with the snake puzzle
[/list]

notes.content:
One found major bug has been quickly fixed.

[b]Gameplay improvements[/b]
- fixed a bug where the 8th compartment becomes unavailable. 
[i](Bug: train is stopped and 8th compartment is not available. Bug occurs when player tries to enter 6th compartment after train stopping. Just visit an area with door to 6th compartment again. notes.title: Last Memories is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello!

The long awaited release of Last Memories has finally happened. It took a lot of effort and time to make it real. The game was originally scheduled to be released in the spring. There were problems, up to the cancellation of the release. But they all were managed to be solved. And now the game is available for everyone!

To celebrate it, the game is available at a [b]15% launch discount[/b]  🎁

[i]I also want to wish you a wonderful mood and best of luck![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43493016/3bbf426e7a1e9fa241d156f63f2cd2269db7f1a0.png[/img]

notes.title: «Last Memories» comes out on November 9th
notes.content:
If you're somewhat familiar with my game, you may know that I've been working on it solo for over 5 years. The original release date was set for this spring, but unforeseen difficulties arose, causing a half year delay. The game was even on the brink of not being released at all. 

However, I'm glad to announce that all the challenges have been overcome, and I'm excited to reveal that the game will be launching very soon – on November 9th. For those eagerly awaiting its release and expressing interest, you'll be able to experience it in just under a week. 

[previewyoutube=dW4T8sXvLrE;full][/previewyoutube]
If you are not yet familiar with the game, you can learn more about it on its page. It's a point-and-click adventure game with a branching storyline featuring multiple endings. The game offers varying difficulty levels, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced players.

A small bonus will also be waiting for you 🎁

Thanks! [i]Wishing you the best of luck![/i]
